description: Claim Jump: Quiet Seam: radio lead-in, calls and sign-offs.

briefing: There is a seam in {system} and someone is working it who should not be. Move them on.
Claim holders, two miners and two guards. {client} wants the seam empty.
A small job. Clear the claim.
success: The claim is clear. {client} pays {captain} and sends in its own crew.
All gone. The seam is open.
failure: The holders stay. {client} loses the seam.
You are driven off the claim.
radio-claim: Miners on the seam. Two guards on watch.
Claim ahead. They have seen you.
Holders in view. Take the guards, then the miners.
radio-owners: More of them coming from the right.
Two more fighters. They want the seam.
